note: Presets are saved parameter sets for the same animation; they do not count as additional animations. All content is fictional and illustrative; which entry lists a term is a supplied datum, not a finding.

presets.name: baseline-illustrative
presets.description: The term 'listed item' pinned to its definition entry (row 2) in another section is inspected and replaced by 'register', which the definitions page lists at row 3: the cord re-pins to that entry.

presets.name: contrast-or-alternative
presets.description: Substantive alternative: the new term is listed by no entry of the definitions page (entryRows.after = 0): after the substitution the cord keeps no far end, the entry highlight goes off and a descriptive 'no entry' tag appears. The lens opens with a different zoom.
